rejected_or_merged.title: News-content single-response body has no receive-time cap
rejected_or_merged.reason: The fact is real, but it is the same ai_query/get_news_content fetch-cache root cause and overlapping bounded-cache remedy already recorded by F22 and F54.

confirmed_findings.title: SSE worker self-joins and shutdown joins before stop
confirmed_findings.scenario: The SSE worker calls closeSession on disconnect, moves out its own joinable thread and joins it; shutdown also holds sseMutex and joins while running remains true. This can terminate on disconnect or deadlock shutdown, and running is a cross-thread plain bool.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Make running atomic and stop first; detach session state under lock, join outside the lock from an owner/reaper, and never let a worker join itself.

confirmed_findings.title: Unvalidated MCP cursor can terminate the server
confirmed_findings.scenario: Negative cursors index before a picojson array; malformed or overflowing cursors throw from stoi and escape a thread-pool task with no exception boundary.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Use from_chars with complete prefix/range validation, return InvalidParams, and catch exceptions at the worker boundary.

confirmed_findings.title: ONNX tensor copy mixes byte counts with typed-pointer offsets
confirmed_findings.scenario: totalSize is counted in bytes but added to T* or float*, so normal multi-row or batched float input writes outside the allocated tensor; later rows/images are not shape/type checked.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Track element offsets or use std::byte pointers, checked tensor-size arithmetic, and reject ragged or heterogeneous inputs.

confirmed_findings.title: ONNX inputs accumulate across runs and failures report success
confirmed_findings.scenario: addInput appends on every run while run clears only outputs; a reused inferencer supplies duplicate inputs and runSync swallows exceptions without setting failure although the caller returns true.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Give inputs per-run lifecycle and propagate/update failure and callback state consistently.

confirmed_findings.title: NIS UBO uploads the address of the config pointer
confirmed_findings.scenario: GL receives &_config where _config is NISConfig*, so it reads sizeof(NISConfig) bytes from the member-pointer slot and beyond instead of the config object. No in-tree call site currently wires this component.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Pass _config after a null check, prefer RAII/by-value storage, and verify uploaded bytes in a GL mock test.

confirmed_findings.title: ImGui event and draw traversals mutate one context concurrently
confirmed_findings.scenario: The main event traversal calls ImGui IO APIs and writes mouse state while PRE_DRAW consumes/resets the same state and calls NewFrame under DrawThreadPerContext, allowing normal input to race ImGui event-vector mutation.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Queue immutable input events under a mutex, drain and call all ImGui APIs on the draw thread, and publish capture state atomically.

confirmed_findings.title: Python wrapper uses unconstructed non-trivial C++ members
confirmed_findings.scenario: tp_alloc supplies raw Python storage but the wrapper assigns two osg::ref_ptr values and a std::string without constructors, then frees storage without their destructors.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Placement-construct and explicitly destroy an RAII payload, or store a normal holder behind a capsule/pybind holder.

confirmed_findings.title: BlendShape base pose aliases output arrays
confirmed_findings.scenario: Backup stores live array pointers rather than copies, so vertex restore is a self-copy and normal/tangent data is never restored; persistent morph weights accumulate every frame.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Deep-copy all base arrays, restore before applying weights, validate empty and per-channel lengths, and add a two-frame idempotence test.

confirmed_findings.title: Aim IK uses chain position as skeleton joint id
confirmed_findings.scenario: Later chain steps use _models[i-1]/_models[i] and write joint i rather than chain[i].joint; non-contiguous chains corrupt unrelated joints, while empty/oversized inputs are unchecked.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Use validated chain joint ids for every transform/write and test non-contiguous, empty and out-of-range chains.

confirmed_findings.title: Removing a rigid body leaves Bullet constraints on freed bodies
confirmed_findings.scenario: removeBody deletes a body and shape without removing constraints that retain A/B references; the next simulation step or later constraint removal can use freed memory. Duplicate names also leave active untracked constraints.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Track constraints by body and remove them first, or reject constrained removal; replace duplicate names through removeConstraint and test both API orders.

confirmed_findings.title: Drawer2D context and worker ownership is incomplete
confirmed_findings.scenario: The context begins indeterminate, finish deletes without nulling, no destructor owns worker shutdown, explicit copies share raw state, and the worker dereferences an observer after its loop. Current in-tree calls are paired and do not copy.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Use RAII/null initialization, idempotent finish and destructor join; make worker ownership non-copyable and recheck observers.
confirmed_findings.condition: public API misuse or exceptional teardown

confirmed_findings.title: SerializerBaseItem edit flag is uninitialized
confirmed_findings.scenario: The first checkEdited reads an indeterminate _edited value and can cause a phantom Scene Editor refresh.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Initialize _edited(false) in declaration order or in-class and test constructor state.

confirmed_findings.title: gzip output can overflow a fixed 10x buffer
confirmed_findings.scenario: readGZip ignores out_size and zlib results, accumulates all output and memcpy's it into compressed_size*10; a valid response with compression ratio above 10:1 writes past the vector.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Use a bounded dynamic result or capacity-aware streaming, cap total output/ratio and validate every zlib status through Z_STREAM_END.

confirmed_findings.title: B3DM and I3DM headers and section lengths are unchecked
confirmed_findings.scenario: Only size>4 is required before fixed 28/32-byte copies; signed file lengths feed unchecked offset arithmetic, iterators, memcpy and size-offset on local or remote 3D Tiles.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Use an explicit little-endian checked parser, validate minimum header/magic/version/declared total and every section interval before pointer arithmetic.

confirmed_findings.title: KTX malloc buffer is released with scalar delete
confirmed_findings.scenario: ktxTexture_WriteToMemory returns malloc/realloc storage but the ostream writer executes delete buffer, causing repeatable allocator mismatch and heap undefined behavior.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Use the KTX ownership API or free and wrap the buffer in RAII.

confirmed_findings.title: LCC index can drive reads outside mmap slices
confirmed_findings.scenario: index.bin controls offsets, byte sizes and numSplats; truncating end iterators does not stop parsers from reading 32/64 bytes per declared splat, and SH slices lack independent checks.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Checked-validate start/end and count*recordSize for geometry and SH; reject instead of truncating and continuing.

confirmed_findings.title: quantized-mesh counts can force unbounded allocation and parse desynchronization
confirmed_findings.scenario: File counts directly resize multiple vectors without remaining-byte, limit, multiplication or stream-state checks, allowing huge allocation, allocation failure, arithmetic wrap and misparsed trailing data.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Consume against total input length, use checked count*stride arithmetic, cap vertices/triangles/edges and validate every read.
confirmed_findings.condition: terrain file or remote tile input

confirmed_findings.title: 3D Tiles transform can throw or use uninitialized elements
confirmed_findings.scenario: Any array is indexed at 0..15 with at; short arrays throw beyond the reader boundary, while non-number values leave double m[16] entries indeterminate.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Require exactly 16 finite numbers in initialized storage and return a parse error for any invalid element.

confirmed_findings.title: Remote glTF external resources bypass tinygltf size limits
confirmed_findings.scenario: GetFileSizeInBytes assigns the local pointer rather than its pointee and returns success, so the guard sees zero; the full HTTP body is then copied without a cap.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Supply verified Content-Length and enforce a receive-time hard cap even when length is unknown, followed by actual-size validation.

confirmed_findings.title: FileCache reader-writer map races across pager threads
confirmed_findings.scenario: One shared FileCache performs unsynchronized find and insert on _cachedReaderWriters while Earth Explorer starts many database and HTTP pager threads; concurrent first extension lookup can corrupt the map.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Protect with a mutex, resolve Registry outside the lock and double-check on insert; add concurrent first-lookup coverage.

confirmed_findings.title: InteractiveMesh MIT inventory omits LGPL-marked compiled headers
confirmed_findings.scenario: The inventory says MIT, while InteractiveMeshBool headers used by the CINOLIB_FOUND build explicitly state LGPL-3.0-or-later, making the supported-build license inventory inaccurate.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Confirm upstream boundaries, ship the correct license texts and mixed-license description, and add inventory drift checks. Distribution obligations require counsel.

confirmed_findings.title: MeshOptimizer inventory version differs from vendored source
confirmed_findings.scenario: The inventory says 0.26 while meshoptimizer.h defines version 210 (0.21), skewing maintenance and vulnerability matching.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Correct the inventory or fully upgrade, and record upstream commit/content hash.

confirmed_findings.title: macOS packaging embeds a live AI key in the distributable plist
confirmed_findings.scenario: When EARTH_AI_KEY is exported, the script writes the literal billable credential to Contents/Info.plist/LSEnvironment where every app recipient can read it.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Never bundle credentials; use per-user config or Keychain, block/warn on key presence during packaging and assert the final plist contains no key.

confirmed_findings.title: Runtime imgui.ini can be written inside the signed bundle
confirmed_findings.scenario: The app sets cwd to the executable directory and leaves ImGui's default ini filename; an existing packaged artifact acquired Contents/MacOS/imgui.ini and strict codesign verification failed. A fresh package without it verifies.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Store ImGui settings in Application Support or disable persistence, then smoke-run and strictly verify the final bundle.
confirmed_findings.condition: packaged macOS app; not proven to fail every first launch

confirmed_findings.title: Packaging reports success when codesign fails
confirmed_findings.scenario: codesign failure is masked by an echo and the script still exits successfully with Built:, allowing unsigned or partially signed output into automation.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Fail closed and run codesign --verify --deep --strict; require explicit opt-in for local unsigned artifacts.

confirmed_findings.title: Test executables are not registered with CTest
confirmed_findings.scenario: NEW_TEST only creates executables; there is no enable_testing or add_test, so CTest reports zero despite six deterministic offline Earth/AI/parser tests and 42 built test/example binaries.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Enable CTest and register deterministic offline targets with labels, timeouts and controlled fixtures; keep interactive examples separate.

confirmed_findings.title: HTTPS development server listens on all interfaces and serves cwd
confirmed_findings.scenario: Certificate mode binds 0.0.0.0 using SimpleHTTPRequestHandler and wildcard CORS. Documented use serves a WASM build directory, so routine source/key exposure is not established.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Default to loopback, require explicit bind and directory options for LAN use, and optionally deny dotfiles/wildcard CORS.

confirmed_findings.title: Linux Docker image ignores the reviewed checkout
confirmed_findings.scenario: The Dockerfile has no COPY and clones mutable remote branches/heads, so a build initiated from commit 223f8d42 can contain unrelated future osgVerse and dependency code.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: COPY the current context or require and verify immutable commits/digests; record source revision and SBOM in the image.

confirmed_findings.title: Release binaries default to the build host's x86 ISA
confirmed_findings.scenario: Host cpuinfo/sysctl features are translated into global AVX/AVX2 and conditional AVX-512 flags; artifacts can fault on older supported machines and cross builds use host instead of target.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Use an explicit conservative distribution baseline, make native opt-in and use runtime dispatch or separate optimized objects.
confirmed_findings.condition: x86 builds with default SIMD detection

confirmed_findings.title: Android release signing is a tracked placeholder
confirmed_findings.scenario: assembleRelease is wired to nonexistent placeholder keystore/password fields; supported docs mainly use assembleDebug, but the template encourages editing secrets into tracked source.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Load signing from environment or ignored keystore.properties only when complete, provide a clear failure otherwise, and ignore common keystore extensions.

confirmed_findings.title: macOS package helper hardcodes osgPlugins-3.6.5
confirmed_findings.scenario: The build derives the actual OSG plugin version, but the helper always copies 3.6.5 and fails or omits plugins for other supported OSG versions.
confirmed_findings.fix_hint: Discover and validate the installed plugin directory from generated metadata or the install tree.
confirmed_findings.condition: macOS build against OSG other than 3.6.5
